programme.desc: Tired of waiting for Mr. Right while her biological clock ticks away, Zoe (Jennifer Lopez) decides it's time to make an appointment at the sperm bank. On the same day as her procedure, she meets Stan (Alex O'Loughlin), a man with the potential to be her ideal mate. When Stan learns that Zoe's unpredictable behavior is the result of her pregnancy, he declares his commitment. As the due date approaches, both lovers realize that they really don't know each other without a baby in the picture.

programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Border Feud
programme.desc: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon
programme.desc: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Black Hills
programme.desc: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Little Big Horn

John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: The Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: The Hawk of Powder River
programme.desc: Vivian Chambers (Jennifer Holt) has a secret identity. She moonlights as "the Hawk," a villain who leads a gang of criminals. Vivian's uncle owns a ranch, and she wants to commandeer it. After her uncle catches a glimpse of the Hawk's secret lair, Vivian kills him and decides to go after his daughter, Carole (June Carlson), as well. Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Prairie Badmen
programme.desc: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, while the son wants to keep it for themselves. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Prairie Outlaws
programme.desc: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two.

programme.title: The Navajo Kid
programme.desc: Gunslinger Tom Kirk (Bob Steele) is searching for the man who killed his adoptive father and the true identities of his biological parents. He rides into the town where the murder took place, but there Sheriff Landon (Edward Cassidy) warns him against vigilantism. This doesn't stop Tom from pursuing poker player Honest John (I. Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large.

programme.title: American Heart
programme.desc: This unflinching drama tells the story of recently released ex-convict Jack Kelson (Jeff Bridges) as he struggles to begin a new life outside of prison and build a relationship with his estranged teenage son Nick (Edward Furlong). With the deck stacked against them, Jack falls back on old habits as they struggle amid the vagrants and criminals of an impoverished section of Seattle. Just when it appears that they might succeed, Jack's past comes back to haunt him.

programme.title: Played
programme.desc: Rival gangs hire a British thug (Mick Rossi), who was imprisoned for eight years, to complete a hit in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Blackheart
programme.desc: A con artist (Richard Grieco) leaves his partner for dead and pursues a woman (Fiona Loewi) with a $10 million inheritance.

programme.title: All Souls Day: Dia de los Muertos
programme.desc: When young lovers Joss (Travis Wester) and Alicia (Marisa Ramirez) arrive in a small Mexican town, they inadvertently stumble upon an attempted human sacrifice. Eventually they find their way to the local sheriff, Blanco (David Keith), and begin to piece together the supernatural puzzle, which involves the dead rising from their graves. As the village's dark history is revealed, it becomes clear that the evil stems from the immortal Vargas Diaz (Danny Trejo), who must be stopped at any cost.

programme.title: Chappaquiddick
programme.desc: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious and scandalous events forever alters Kennedy's political legacy -- and ultimately changes the course of presidential history.

programme.desc: A criminal syndicate has been illegally freeing convicts, only to murder them after authorities offer reward money for the fugitives' scalps. Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are charged with catching the thugs, and they hit upon a plan: Dave will get himself put in jail, the thugs break him free and Tex and Panhandle will arrest them. But, when the criminals realize the Rangers are closing in, things turn deadly.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Bar 20 Justice
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy gets the drop on some miners robbing ore from the heroine's mine.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

programme.title: Tumbleweed Trail
programme.desc: Scheming to steal Bill Ryan's (Kermit Maynard) cattle to pay a debt, his half-brother, Brad Barton (Bob Duncan), has his men shoot the rancher. With Bill left for dead, Brad and corrupt lawyer Alton Small (Ted Adams) produce a forged will that disinherits Bill's teenage daughter, Robin (Shirley Patterson), and son Freckles (Johnny McGovern). Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property.

programme.title: Wild Country
programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.title: Yankee Fakir
programme.desc: Yankee Davis (Douglas Fowley) and his partner, professor Newton (Ransom Sherman), are a pair of traveling hucksters on their way to a town in Arizona. Soon after they arrive, Yankee falls for a local girl, Mary Mason (Joan Woodbury). Mary's lawman father turns up dead, and Yankee is sure the man was murdered, but the death is ruled an accident. Believing something's off, Yankee has an elderly associate, Shaggy (Clem Bevans), pose as a rich man and offer a reward for clues about the killing.

programme.desc: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers.

programme.desc: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought.

programme.title: Call of the Jungle
programme.desc: Trouble comes to a tropical island paradise when sacred pearls are stolen from a tribal temple. Local amateur sleuth Tana (Ann Corio) decides to investigate the matter to find out who's responsible, but following leads only earns her a place on the authorities' list of suspects. Meanwhile, a police officer, Jim (James Bush), is injured while working on the case, and Tana, nursing him back to health, attempts to get him to team up with her to track down the real crooks.

programme.title: The Emerald Forest
programme.desc: American Bill Markham (Powers Boothe) has taken his family to the jungles of Brazil, where he has been hired to design a dam. Unexpectedly, a native tribe abducts his son, Tommy (Charley Boorman). Bill spends an entire decade looking for Tommy, only to discover that the boy has adopted the ways of the indigenous people he's been living with. Bill tries to convince his son to return to his family, but their reunion is interrupted when another group of natives attacks Tommy's tribe.

programme.title: Solomon and Sheba
programme.desc: Near death, King David has a vision that his poet son, Solomon (Yul Brynner), should succeed him, rather than hot-headed Adonijah (George Sanders). Furious, Adonijah departs the court, swearing he will become king. Other rulers are concerned that Solomon's benevolent rule and interest in monotheism will threaten their tyrannical, polytheistic kingdoms. The Queen of Sheba (Gina Lollobrigida) makes an agreement with the Egyptian pharaoh (David Farrar) to corrupt Solomon for their mutual benefit.

programme.title: The Satan Bug
programme.desc: Special Agent Lee Barrett (George Maharis) joins forces with Ann Williams (Anne Francis), a general's daughter, to recover a biological weapon stolen from a secret government lab. Learning that the pathogen could destroy all life on Earth, they focus their attention on a mysterious millionaire who may have orchestrated the theft. After annihilating a small town in Florida, the villain turns his attention to Los Angeles -- and the duo must race to stop the city's destruction.

programme.title: Call of the Wild
programme.desc: Based on Jack London's classic about two gold-seekers who forge their way to the Klondike with their faithful dog Buck.

programme.title: True Heart
programme.desc: Twin brother and sister Sam and Bonnie, who argue frequently, become stranded after surviving a horrific plane crash in the Canadian wilderness. While struggling through the forest, they meet a wily Native North American named Khonanesta, who agrees to help them reunite with their family. As the trio traverses the treacherous wood, they strive to elude poachers who wish to hunt Khonanesta's adored Kodiak bear companion.

On their way through the still violent storm, each shares the tale from his past that has affected him to this day.

programme.title: Legend of the Lost
programme.desc: Brit Paul Bonnard (Rossano Brazzi) enlists gruff American Joe January (John Wayne) to help him find a hidden treasure that is worth a fortune. Before long, they are joined by prostitute Dita (Sophia Loren), who is moved by Bonnard's earnestness, and the three embark on a journey through the wild in hopes of finding an ancient lost city. They finally stumble upon the riches, but, after Bonnard feuds with Dita, he angrily takes the jewels and supplies, and leaves his partners to die in the desert.

programme.title: The Comedy of Terrors
programme.desc: Waldo Trumbull (Vincent Price) is an amoral undertaker in 19th-century New England who takes to murdering people to have enough cash to support his drinking habit. Desperate for money after a widow stiffs him for a burial, Trumbull and his assistant, Gillie (Peter Lorre), decide to kill the wealthy Mr. Black (Basil Rathbone), their landlord, to whom they're indebted. But murdering Black proves to be quite a challenge, as he seems to keep recovering from death every time they do him in.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 2: Unhappy Campers
programme.desc: Angela Baker (Pamela Springsteen), a psychotic transsexual, escapes from a mental hospital and surfaces at a summer camp as a counselor who lectures her teenage charges on proper moral behavior. Those teens who break her strict rules -- from the camp chatterbox or a sex-obsessed girl to the boys who are peeping Toms -- are murdered by the impostor in various gruesome ways. As more campers go missing, intrepid counselor Molly (Renee Estevez) begins to piece together the truth.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 3: Teenage Wasteland
programme.desc: Psychotic Angela (Pamela Springsteen) is itching to do what she does best: slaughter dozens of teenage campers. As luck would have it, the previous site of her murders has been renamed and converted into an experimental summer camp meant to bring together privileged and lower-class teens. On the day the youths are boarding the buses to camp, Angela runs over a potential camper with a garbage truck and assumes her identity. Once she has infiltrated the camp, the real terror begins.

programme.title: Dr. Heckyl and Mr. Hype
programme.desc: The kind but physically disfigured Dr. Heckyl is so distraught over his continual failures with the opposite sex that he decides to end his life by overdosing on an extra-strength diet drink. Strangely, he doesn't die -- he transforms into slick stud Mr. Hype. Unfortunately, Hype has an insatiable thirst for blood, and he ends up killing his dates before any romance unfolds. He soon sets his sights on the sweet Coral, who secretly loves Heckyl, but not Hype.

programme.title: Blood Vows: The Story of a Mafia Wife
programme.desc: Fashion designer Marian (Melissa Gilbert) meets the man of her dreams, dashing lawyer Edward Moran (Joe Penny). Their attraction is instant, but after the lovebirds get married, Marian makes a shocking discovery about her in-laws: They're in the Mafia, and that includes her dear husband, Edward. programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: A government agent (Richard Todd) searches Venice for a World War II hero turned assassin.

programme.title: We Still Kill the Old Way
programme.desc: A teacher (Gian Maria Volonte) falls for a woman (Irene Papas) whose husband was recently murdered on a hunting trip.

programme.title: A Kiss Before Dying
programme.desc: Amoral Bud Corliss (Robert Wagner) pursues young heiress Dorie Kingship (Joanne Woodward) in the hopes of getting his hands on the fortune amassed by her father (George Macready). But after Dorie succumbs to Bud's charms and becomes pregnant as a result, he fears she'll be cut off by the family and murders her in a fashion that makes it look as if the poor girl committed suicide. When Bud tries to cozy up with Dorie's grieving sister, Ellen (Virginia Leith), she begins to suspect his intentions.

programme.title: Vice Squad
programme.desc: Capt. Barnaby (Edward G. Robinson), leader of the Los Angeles Vice Squad, is trying to track down the murderers of a beat cop. To do this, he pulls some strings to coerce help from Mona Ross (Paulette Goddard), the madam behind a local escort ring. Using this lead and further help from an informant, Barnaby hunts down a pair of bank robbers he suspects are the killers. However, the criminals prove to be hard to catch, so Barnaby must stay determined.

programme.title: Tomorrow Is Forever
programme.desc: In 1918, Elizabeth MacDonald (Claudette Colbert) learns with shock that her husband, John Andrew (Orson Welles), has been killed in the war. Elizabeth bears John's son and eventually marries her kindly boss. Unknown to her, John has survived but is horribly disfigured and remains in Europe. Years later, on the eve of World War II, Elizabeth refuses to agree to her son's request to enlist and is stunned when an eerily familiar stranger named Kessler arrives from abroad and becomes involved.

programme.title: Separate Tables
programme.desc: During the off-season at the Beauregard Hotel, the secrets of some guests are exposed. Lovely but vulnerable Ann Shankland (Rita Hayworth) travels to the hotel in hopes of starting over with her ex-husband, John (Burt Lancaster), but she does not know that he is already engaged to Pat Cooper (Wendy Hiller), the manager of the hotel. Meanwhile, Mrs. Railton-Bell (Gladys Cooper) and her daughter Sibyl (Deborah Kerr) discover the hidden truth about war veteran Major Pollack (David Niven).

programme.title: Lady of Vengeance
programme.desc: When publisher William Marshall (Dennis O'Keefe) learns his young ward Melissa Collins (Eileen Elton) has committed suicide, he sets in motion a plan to murder the man who drove her to kill herself. Mistakenly believing that singer Larry Shaw (Vernon Greeves) is his intended target, Marshall unwittingly seeks help from the man who actually broke Melissa's heart, criminal Emile Karnak (Anton Diffring). When Marshall learns the truth, however, he turns his efforts toward Karnak instead.

programme.title: For Those Who Think Young
programme.desc: Youth is in full swing at Oceancrest College, and no place swings harder than the Silver Palms, the choice hot spot for student Sandy (Pamela Tiffin) and her pals. Sandy's uncle, Woody (Woody Woodbury), who performs a comedy act at the club, has his livelihood threatened when wealthy conservative Edgar Cronin (Robert Middleton) attempts to shutter the wild hangout for good. This makes things especially sticky for Cronin's grandson, Ding (James Darren), who's trying to get a date with Sandy.

programme.title: Just for Kicks
programme.desc: A stranger tries to help twin brothers (Cole Sprouse, Dylan Sprouse) who play for a winless soccer team.

programme.title: Ski Party
programme.desc: In this musical, college classmates Todd Armstrong (Frankie Avalon) and Craig Gamble (Dwayne Hickman) head out on a group ski vacation, and agree that if they're going to get girlfriends, they need to understand how women think. So when they arrive at the ski lodge, Todd and Craig dress up as young women and pal around with female classmates. Though this provides a bit of insight, the plan goes awry when a male classmate falls for the female version of Craig and pursues him all over the resort.

programme.title: Top Banana
programme.desc: Tyrannical TV star Jerry Biffle (Phil Silvers) wants to boost the sagging ratings for his comedy series. What better way to do that than by casting a couple of hot young bodies -- Sally Peters (Judy Lynn) and Cliff Lane (Danny Scholl) -- as eye candy for the viewing public? The plan gets complicated when Jerry falls for Sally, who really loves Cliff. Adapted from the hit Broadway musical, "Top Banana" is notable for filming the actual stage production on the original sets.

programme.title: Beach Party
programme.desc: Dolores (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon), attractive young surfers in Southern California, are just out for a good time. Their relaxed lifestyle fascinates Professor Sutwell (Bob Cummings), an anthropologist who decides to study the social lives of teens. A series of beach-themed films would follow the blueprint set by this one, which hinges on romantic rivalries, rugged motorcyclists, an attempted crime and plenty of handsome people.

programme.title: Sergeant Deadhead
programme.desc: After setting off a rocket during a parade, Sergeant Deadhead (Frankie Avalon) is sent to a guardhouse by his commanding officer, General Fogg (Fred Clark). While attempting to escape, Deadhead accidentally boards a rocket and launches himself into space with a chimpanzee. Deadhead and the chimpanzee are eventually recovered by the air force, but upon his return to Earth, it becomes clear that Deadhead has undergone an unbelievable personality change.

programme.title: De Sade
programme.desc: The 18th-century French marquis (Keir Dullea) recalls his sadomasochistic experiments and goes to jail for lewd behavior.

programme.title: Clambake
programme.desc: A wealthy young man, Scott Heyward (Elvis Presley) wants to experience life outside his privileged upbringing. When he meets Tom Wilson (Will Hutchins), an earnest water-skiing instructor, Scott offers to trade places with him. As Tom warms up to the good life, Scott gets used to a less luxurious existence and falls for Dianne Carter (Shelley Fabares), who, ironically, is hoping to meet a rich man. Sticking to his humble guise, Scott tries to woo Dianne without the benefit of his true status.

programme.title: Matchless
programme.desc: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible.

programme.title: He Who Must Die
programme.desc: Three townspeople cause an uproar when they try to help refugees on a Greek island occupied by Turks.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

programme.title: Extremities
programme.desc: Marjorie (Farrah Fawcett) manages to fight off a rapist and flee to safety. Because her attacker got away and Marjorie has no proof of the crime, police officers tell her there is little they can do. Because Marjorie's attacker also stole her purse, she fears that he will use its contents to track her down. When Joe (James Russo) does show up at Marjorie's house to finish what he started, he discovers that Marjorie is not the fragile victim he imagined.

programme.title: A Cold Wind in August
programme.desc: A 28-year-old stripper (Lola Albright) on vacation seduces the 17-year-old son (Scott Marlowe) of her New York building's superintendent.

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: Frustrated by his inability to help an African-American patient who hates whites, a psychiatrist (Peter Falk) asks his superior (Sidney Poitier) to release him from the case. The superior relates a case from his own past during World War II when he treated a young Nazi (Bobby Darin) who despised blacks. Explaining the tragic results of the case, the older psychiatrist encourages his younger colleague not to be swayed by the patient's attitude, to remain objective and to stick with his treatment.

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Despite being far from home, American jazz musicians Ram Bowen (Paul Newman) and Eddie Cook (Sidney Poitier) are content living and working in Paris. Ram knows it's the best place for him to develop his musical reputation, and Eddie is far away from the racism that once greeted him on a regular basis. But after meeting and falling in love with American tourists Lillian (Joanne Woodward) and Connie (Diahann Carroll), the pair must decide whether their artistic integrity is worth abandoning.

programme.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
programme.desc: In this sequel to "In The Heat of the Night," Detective Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier) must solve the murder of a prostitute. The last person witnessed with the victim is Tibbs' friend, Logan Sharpe (Martin Landau), a preacher and activist. Despite his loyalty, Tibbs must investigate when Sharpe admits having visited the prostitute. In addition to his police work, Tibbs must also ease tension with his wife (Barbara McNair), who wants him to spend more time with her and their children.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: The Wild Pair
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: Frustrated by his inability to help an African-American patient who hates whites, a psychiatrist (Peter Falk) asks his superior (Sidney Poitier) to release him from the case. The superior relates a case from his own past during World War II when he treated a young Nazi (Bobby Darin) who despised blacks. Explaining the tragic results of the case, the older psychiatrist encourages his younger colleague not to be swayed by the patient's attitude, to remain objective and to stick with his treatment.

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

programme.title: The Return of Sabata
programme.desc: The third in a trilogy about the eponymous lone gunman, this one finds Sabata (Lee Van Cleef) working as a sharpshooter for a circus that's just stopped in an ailing one-horse town. The circus gig is only a front, however: Sabata is actually on the verge of robbing town mayor Joe McIntock (Giampiero Albertini). The mayor's been levying heavy taxes as part of a complex plan to defraud the community, but Sabata manages to rip him off first, only to discover that the money is counterfeit.

programme.title: Ride Out for Revenge
programme.desc: Under the eye of timid Capt. George (Lloyd Bridges), a group of Cheyenne Native Americans are on a forced march from their homelands to a reservation. When builders strike gold on their new settlement, the Cheyenne are diverted to make way for greedy prospectors. Tate (Rory Calhoun), who is secretly in love with Pretty Willow, is sent to scout a new location for the Cheyenne. Tensions quickly arise between the cavalry and the vengeful Chief Little Wolf (Vince Edwards).

programme.title: The Iroquois Trail
programme.desc: Trapper Hawkeye (George Montgomery) and guide Sagamore help a British captain (Glenn Langan) in the French and Indian War.

programme.title: Comanche
programme.desc: Renegade Comanche leader Black Cloud (Henry Brandon) attacks a Mexican village and kidnaps the beautiful Margarita Alvarez (Linda Cristal). Fleeing to the United States, they come across a band of scalp hunters and are prevented from massacring them by the Comanche chief of the Antelope tribe, Quanah (Kent Smith). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace.

programme.title: Geronimo
programme.desc: Apache leader Geronimo (Chuck Connors) tires of battling American and Mexican troops, and decides to surrender his meager tribe. However, life on the San Carlos reservation is difficult, and the Apaches do not adjust well to becoming farmers. Geronimo is befriended by a schoolteacher (Kamala Devi), who tries to broaden his horizons, but corruption on the reservation forces him to take his band and head for the mountains, where the Apaches wage a doomed war against the white man.

Billings (Robert Stack) and his troopers are in a race against time to avoid all-out war. programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: A marksman's wife convinces him not to take a greedy casino owner up on an agreement to kill Bat, but the casino owner looks for a way to force the murder by any means necessary.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Angered over several recent mine disasters, Sheriff Hollister wages a campaign for mine safety legislation with the aid of Editor Claiborne of the Tombstone Epitaph; in the process, they uncover a clever ruse to discredit the safety campaign.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Adam Kirby witnesses a murder in the livery stable; then makes the mistake of shooting off his mouth about it, leading to the killer coming after him; Sheriff Hollister baits a trap with Kirby and waits to trap the killer and save Kirby.

programme.title: The Brass Legend
programme.desc: Sheriff Wade Addams is engaged to Linda Gipson and searching for an elusive killer, Tris Hatten. Linda's little brother, Clay, happens upon Tris' hideout one day, and immediately notifies Wade, who arrests the killer. Despite efforts to keep Clay's involvement a secret, the details come out and Clay's life is threatened. Wade must protect Clay while sidestepping attempts on his own life by Tris' henchmen.

programme.title: Cannon for Cordoba
programme.desc: During the 1912 Mexican Revolution, rebel leader Hector Córdoba (Raf Vallone) and his bloodthirsty revolutionaries slip across the Texas border and liberate a number of cannons from a U.S. Army fort. Under direct orders from General Pershing (John Russell), Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) heads into Mexican territory to face down Córdoba and get back the American cannons with the help of Mexican military officer Antonio (Gabriele Tinti) and alluring local Leonora (Giovanna Ralli).

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: Thanks to his prowess with a gun, Dave Robles (Anthony Quinn) makes a place for himself in Mesa, becoming sheriff after out-dueling several gunfighters in a single day. But Robles, a Mexican, seethes over the town's racism, and is warned by kindly nurse Estella (Katy Jurado) that without his gun, he would not last very long. That theory is put to the test when the new sheriff injures his wrist fighting with Ed Bannister (Peter Whitney), who upon learning about it, challenges Robles to a duel.

programme.title: Cast a Long Shadow
programme.desc: Chip (John Dehner), a ranch foreman, approaches aimless hard-drinker Matt Brown (Audie Murphy) in a New Mexico bar. The owner of Chip's ranch has died and left Matt his land, thinking the troubled drifter may be his long-estranged son. Initially, Matt plans on selling the ranch, but then decides to keep it, hoping to impress his ex-lover, Janet (Terry Moore). The ranch, however, turns out to be in foreclosure, forcing Matt and Chip to come up with a plan to pay off their debt to the bank.

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: The year is 1908, and aging adventurer Sam Longwood (Lee Marvin) and his gang of crooked cowboys have been cheated out of a big score by their own cohort, Jack Colby (Robert Culp). After years of searching, Sam finally tracks Colby down and decides to take revenge against his former accomplice. Sam regroups his old circle of grifters, and they hatch a scheme to get their hands on Colby's fortune; however, nothing seems to go smoothly for these ramshackle scam artists.

programme.title: Sonora Stagecoach
programme.desc: The Trail Blazers (Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele, Chief Thundercloud) escort an innocent man to a fair trial.

programme.title: Gun Belt
programme.desc: After giving up his gunfighting ways, Billy Ringo (George Montgomery) has settled down with his new wife, Arlene (Helen Westcott), on a ranch he's just purchased with his brother, Matt (John Dehner), and nephew Chip (Tab Hunter). programme.title: Live: Hot Stove
programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others.

programme.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Based on the beloved children's book by Dr. Seuss, "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" follows the exploits of the title character who is infuriated by the celebration he sees down in Whoville each year at Christmastime. He vows to stop it and -- dressed as Santa -- drives a sleigh into town on Christmas Eve, removing all traces of the impending celebration. A gambler in debt, Terence Keath (Robert Walker), pursues her. But so does another bachelor on the hunt, playboy Jeremy Taylor (Peter Lawford), who is traveling with his lawyer, Matthew Kinston (Mark Stevens), to whom Kirbe is most attracted. Unfortunately for her, he thinks she's running a scam.

programme.title: The Law in Her Hands

The two are even forced to live together, much to the dismay of Lucy's boyfriend, Tom (Richard Anderson). At first Mark tries to ditch Lucy and her frugal ways, but soon he finds himself falling for her.

programme.title: Adam's Rib

Working on opposite sides of a lawsuit where a woman (Judy Holliday) has shot her cheating husband (Tom Ewell), Adam and Amanda are both determined to win the case, and their home becomes the setting for comical showdowns, with neither spouse willing to relent.

programme.sub-title: Ruta 66, EE. UU.: De Nuevo México a California
programme.desc: El 250.o aniversario de los Estados Unidos es la excusa perfecta para unas vacaciones de verano y un gran viaje por carretera al estilo estadounidense. ¿Qué mejor ruta para recorrer que la Ruta 66 en el año de su centenario? Un recorrido por la Ruta 66 te sumerge en la historia del país.

programme.title: Emma Fielding Mysteries

programme.title: Emma Fielding Mysteries

When Timmy tries to resolve his parents' issues for them, emotional chaos ensues.

programme.title: The Trouble With Harry
programme.desc: When a local man's corpse appears on a nearby hillside, no one is quite sure what happened to him. Many of the town's residents secretly wonder if they are responsible, including the man's ex-wife, Jennifer (Shirley MacLaine), and Capt. As the no-nonsense sheriff (Royal Dano) gets involved and local artist Sam Marlowe (John Forsythe) offers his help, the community slowly unravels the mystery.

programme.desc: The American secretary of defence forms a covert military organisation with the intention of assassinating the president. programme.title: xXx: The Return of Xander Cage

programme.title: xXx

Action adventure, starring Vin Diesel, Samuel L Jackson, Asia Argento, Marton Csokas and Michael Roof.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: A totalitarian future holds an annual nationally televised event in which two children from each of its regions fight to the death until only one remains. A teenage girl takes her younger sister's place in the games and must pit her wits against the deadly combat skills of her rivals. Sci-fi adventure based on Suzanne Collins' novel, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Woody Harrelson and Elizabeth Banks.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen's victory in a televised death match makes her a focus for revolution against the totalitarian nation she lives in. The rulers of the regime plot to crush dissent with a new series of games, in which past champions battle it out. Sci-fi adventure sequel based on the second book in Suzanne Collins' trilogy of novels, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Liam Hemsworth, Donald Sutherland and Philip Seymour Hoffman.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen is brought to a secretive underground society following the destruction of the televised deathmatch. She becomes the figurehead of a revolution against the despotic Panem regime, while her friend Peeta remains a captive of its tyrannical president. Part one of the two-part conclusion to the sci-fi adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Julianne Moore and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: The civilisation of Panem is consumed by a bloody civil war. Reluctant rebel leader Katniss Everdeen leads a band of her allies on a mission to end the conflict at one stroke by assassinating the despotic President Snow - but faces many dangers as she closes in on her target. Conclusion of the sci-fi adventure series based on Suzanne Collins' novels, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Donald Sutherland and Philip Seymour Hoffman in his final role.

programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for Coughton Court in Warwickshire. Amongst the items under scrutiny are original designs from one of Britain's leading graphic artists of the 20th century, a bizarre Japanese depiction of skeletons dancing, and a lost masterpiece valued at £60,000.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and the team are at the Fleet Air Arm Museum situated on HMS Heron, the naval aviation base in Yeovilton, Somerset. Paul is joined by experts Charlie Ross and Thomas Plant, and together they pick out a selection of interesting antiques to be sold at a local auction.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Jake Bhardwaj, Sue Cleaver, Rachel Parris and Rav Wilding take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player?

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor is on hand with more Strictly exclusives and behind-the-scenes action from the Tower Ballroom. Also, she's joined by a brand-new all-star panel to break down the upcoming performances ahead of the weekend's Blackpool Extravaganza.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Featuring extensive coverage of the day's top national and international news stories, along with explanations about the context and potential aftereffects.

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham is joined by Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin for a lively, curiosity-fuelled exploration of Britain's wildlife, tackling the fascinating, the unexpected and the downright bizarre.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses, while Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment.

programme.title: Live: Boxing
programme.desc: Having made history to become Wales's first female boxing world champion and cementing herself among the sport's elite, Lauren Price returns to home soil to defend her unified world welterwight titles against Michaela Kotaskova. Catrin Heledd and the team present live coverage from the Cardiff International Arena.

programme.title: Surf, le feu sacré
programme.desc: Ce documentaire retrace l'évolution du surf, de ses origines polynésiennes à son entrée aux Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024. Il explore comment cette pratique ancestrale est devenue un phénomène mondial, malgré l'opposition initiale des Occidentaux. À travers des archives et des témoignages, le film révèle les moments clés et les figures qui ont marqué cette discipline. De la culture polynésienne aux plages du monde, le surf s'est imposé comme symbole de liberté. Le documentaire offre ainsi un regard captivant sur l'histoire culturelle, politique et sportive de cette pratique qui a conquis les océans.

programme.title: La roue de la fortune
programme.desc: Des candidats vont tenter leur chance pour dénicher les mots et expressions cachés, tout en espérant décrocher les plus gros gains offerts par la roue de la fortune. Mais attention, ils devront éviter la redoutable banqueroute et les autres pièges qu’elle réserve. Chaque jour, trois candidats s'affrontent à travers cinq manches, durant lesquelles ils doivent résoudre une énigme en découvrant un mot ou des expressions. Trouver une consonne leur rapporte de l'argent, tandis que les voyelles sont payantes. À la fin de la cinquième manche, celui ayant amassé le plus d'argent accède à la finale, ce qui lui offre le droit de revenir le lendemain. Lors de la finale, il peut remporter jusqu'à 20 000 euros ou un voyage, à condition de résoudre une ultime énigme en seulement 10 secondes !

programme.title: La meilleure cuisine régionale, c'est chez moi !
programme.desc: De la Bretagne au Grand Est, des Hauts-de-France à la Provence, des dizaines de restaurateurs bien décidés à faire briller leur région vont accueillir chez eux les chefs Norbert Tarayre et Yoann Conte ! Leur but : partager et faire découvrir la plus typique, la plus gourmande, la plus authentique des spécialités locales afin de remporter le titre de meilleur restaurant de leur région. Une compétition faites de secrets culinaires, d’astuces incroyables, de folklore et d’émotion auprès de ceux qui font vivre l’identité gastronomique de nos régions !

programme.title: Brigade anonyme
programme.desc: La juge Kohl, convaincue d'avoir affaire à un tueur en série, doit mettre de côté ses différends avec Casta pour avancer dans l'enquête. Par ailleurs, la brigade anonyme enquête sur la disparition de la petite Suzanne, 7 ans, fille du chef étoilé David Lange qui fait figure de suspect idéal et doit prouver son innocence.

programme.title: Brigade anonyme
programme.desc: Carmen, une étudiante en première année de médecine ressemblant étrangement à Alia, a disparu depuis deux jours. L'enquête de la brigade anonyme prend un tournant inattendu lorsque Casta est arrêté par la police. Charlie et Nass poursuivent leurs recherches, déterminés à retrouver Carmen, tandis que la juge Kohl traque sans relâche le tueur en série avant qu’il ne frappe à nouveau.

programme.title: Brigade anonyme
programme.desc: Casta, Nass, Florence et Charlie sont sollicités par des parents sans nouvelles de leur fille Adèle, tout juste majeure, qui devait rentrer chez eux en Corse après un mois à Royan comme fille au pair. Ils se lancent à sa recherche avec l’aide des anonymes, toujours plus nombreux. En parallèle, Casta reste très méfiant quant à l’implication possible de la mère d’Alia dans la séquestration de sa fille. Florence, elle, continue d’enquêter en secret sur Casta, persuadée qu’il a été mêlé au meurtre de son ancien co-équipier.

programme.title: Brigade anonyme

Casta, Charlie, Nass et Florence se mettent immédiatement à enquêter pour le retrouver au plus vite….

programme.title: Triple je
programme.desc: Ils se ressemblent comme trois gouttes d’eau… mais n’ont rien d’autre en commun ! À 45 ans, Richard Deltour, cadre rigide et tradi, découvre du jour au lendemain qu’il a deux frères jumeaux ! Le premier, David, dirige une association LGBTQIA+ et milite pour un monde plus inclusif. Le second, José, arnaqueur sans talent, enchaîne les galères avec un certain panache, mais la dernière en date pourrait bien lui coûter la vie. Pour Richard, ces retrouvailles virent à la catastrophe. D’autant qu’il décide de cacher leur existence à sa famille ! Il a maintenant une semaine pour ne pas perdre son job, et surtout son épouse, Alice, qui s’apprête à le quitter. Ces triplés que tout oppose vont devoir apprendre à se supporter, et aussi à s’entraider… Et qui sait, peut-être même arriveront-ils à s’apprécier un peu ? Voire à s’aimer ?

programme.desc: Sherlock est enlevé par un gang salvadorien : leur chef aimerait l'engager afin qu'il identifie l'assassin d'un contrebandier avec lequel il faisait affaire.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Après le mystérieux empoisonnement au venin de serpent d'un chef cuisinier et de sept de ses clients experts d'internet, Sherlock mène l'enquête.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Alors qu'il vient dénoncer un assassin avec le capitaine Gregson, Sherlock repère le comportement suspect d'un courtier en bourse. Il décide de l'espionner.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Le commentateur d'une compétition "e-sport" a disparu. Holmes et Watson suivent sa piste et finissent par découvrir son cadavre : des joueurs sont suspectés.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Sherlock s'intéresse à la mort d'un magicien, tué après le sabotage d'un tour. La victime cherchait l'auteur d'un ouvrage de référence dans la magie.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Après l'assassinat d'une policière dans une émission de téléréalité, les soupçons se dirigent sur un des participants, qui s'avère être un criminel.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Sherlock et Watson enquêtent sur la mort d'un Yakuza. Afin de dissimuler son identité, celui-ci portait, à la place du petit doigt, une prothèse cachant une clé U.S.B.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Watson et Holmes se consacrent à une délicate affaire afin de retrouver la trace d'une femme qui a récemment disparu. Un ami de Holmes est suspecté.

programme.title: Elementary

programme.title: Capitaine Marleau

L'enquête révèle qu'une rivalité sentimentale serait à l'origine de l'assassinat.

Sébastien Beaugendre, son ex-mari, est rapidement soupçonné, malgré des lettres anonymes d'un corbeau s'accusant du crime et arrivées fort à propos, mais dont les enquêteurs pensent qu'il en est l'auteur.

Les enquêteurs découvrent chez lui la présence de traces de sang appartenant à Lysiane. Il a été condamné à 30 ans de réclusion criminelle en octobre 2018 par la cour d'assises de Charente-Maritime.

Ensemble, ils préparent tuiles de sarrasin croustillantes, sardines mi-cuites à la rhubarbe poêlée, bouillon d'étrilles, et fonds d'artichauts farcis à la chair d'étrilles, échalotes, salicorne et verveine citronnée.

programme.title: Homard et cordon bleu
programme.desc: Recette : Cailles rôties, chou-fleur en croûte et purée de patate douce. Aujourd'hui, notre chef Sylvain s'invite dans la cuisine d'Amélie, à Nantes. Amélie travaille dans l'événementiel et vit en appartement, ce qui l'amène à rechercher des plats qu'elle peut préparer le soir et réchauffer facilement le lendemain. Ne disposant pas de four, mais...

programme.title: Outremer.l'info
programme.desc: Préparé et proposé par la Rédaction du Pôle Outre-mer Une production France Télévisions Présenté en alternance par Kessi Weishaupt et Laurence Theatin Le journal d'information qui vous emmène au cœur des Outre-mer et de leur actualité.

programme.desc: Une émission réalisée par Captain Productions Une production Enibas Productions, A Prime Group, avec la participation de France Télévisions Rédacteurs en chef : Stéphane Evanno et Laetitia Bouchon Présentée par Marine Vignes et Laurent Romejko En direct Ce nouveau format se veut encore plus interactif. programme.title: Tandem
programme.desc: Une artificière est tuée par une fusée de feu d'artifice. La police découvre que la jeune femme cachait un secret à son mari depuis quelques mois.

programme.title: Tandem

programme.title: Tandem
programme.desc: La présidente de l'Institut botanique de Montpellier est retrouvée morte au milieu des herbiers. Paul avait déjà enquêté dans l'établissement un an auparavant.

programme.title: Stade 2 la quotidienne

programme.desc: Tandis que Clémence constate qu'elle a commis une erreur, Laurine commence à douter de Guillaume.

programme.title: Les bois maudits

programme.title: NCIS

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: De nouvelles informations sur un terroriste remettent à jour l'opération Willoughby et mobilisent toute l'équipe du NCIS ainsi qu'un agent de la NSA.

programme.title: NCIS

programme.title: NCIS

programme.title: NCIS

programme.desc: Crossover avec NCIS : Nouvelle-Orléans.\r\nIntégrée à un groupe de réflexion de la Sécurité Intérieure, Abby a conçu et exécuté une fausse attaque au gaz sarin dans les suites VIP d'une salle de concert. Leur enquête va les mener à la Nouvelle-Orléans, où leurs confrères Pride et LaSalle suivent l'affaire….

programme.title: NCIS

programme.sub-title: S14 E21 - Le droit à l'erreur
programme.desc: Le meurtre d'un Marine lié à un gang de motards contraint Torres à replonger dans une ancienne mission d'infiltration. Pour faire avancer l'enquête, il doit révéler à Gibbs un secret qu'il gardait enfoui depuis cette époque.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: En recherchant un policier disparu après une planque avec Torres, le NCIS découvre une vidéo où il apparaît aux côtés de son ancienne coéquipière, officiellement morte en service dix ans plus tôt. Invité à l'université d'Édimbourg, Ducky reçoit une proposition pour enseigner un semestre à New York.

programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.sub-title: Laurence de Schepper : suicide ou féminicide ? (1/2)
programme.desc:
Le 11 janvier 2018, le corps de Laurence de Schepper, 48 ans, est retrouvé dans les eaux glacées de la Sambre. Sa voiture est découverte à quelques centaines de mètres de son domicile. Très vite, l’enquête s’oriente vers la piste d’un suicide. Il faut dire que Laurence traversait une période difficile. Suivie en psychiatrie pour dépression, fragilisée par des antécédents suicidaires, elle venait tout juste de sortir d’hospitalisation. Elle ne pesait plus que 40 kilos et refusait parfois de s’alimenter. Pour les enquêteurs, ces éléments semblent accréditer la thèse d’un passage à l’acte. Mais pour sa famille, ce scénario ne tient pas. Le soir de sa disparition, pourquoi Laurence serait-elle sortie vêtue d’une simple robe de chambre rose ? Pourquoi ses lunettes, indispensables pour conduire, ne se trouvaient-elles pas dans son véhicule ? Et surtout, comment cette femme qui avait peur de l’eau aurait-elle pu se jeter dans la Sambre, en plein hiver, par –4 °C et avec des rafales de vent atteignant 37 km/h ? Au fil des mois, les questions se multiplient. Ses carnets intimes s’interrompent brusquement en septembre 2017, alors que ses proches assurent qu’elle écrivait encore quelques semaines avant sa mort. Un dernier SMS, reçu par sa fille et censé avoir été envoyé par Laurence, intrigue, lui aussi, la famille : le message provient bien de son téléphone, mais son authenticité est contestée.
Un autre élément attire l’attention : la veille de l’annonce de la disparition, David Cornez, son compagnon, retire 600 euros. Il affirme que Laurence lui aurait demandé cette somme afin d’offrir un cadeau de Noël à ses enfants. Une explication que ces derniers réfutent catégoriquement. Surtout, peu avant sa mort, Laurence aurait confié à ses proches qu’elle souhaitait rompre avec David Cornez et récupérer les clés de son domicile. Une décision qu’il aurait mal acceptée. Et pourquoi a-t-il attendu le lendemain matin pour signaler sa disparition ? Pourquoi a-t-il vidé son compte bancaire ? Enfin, comment expliquer que le bornage de son téléphone le situe à proximité du lieu où Laurence a été retrouvée, entre 9 h 01 et 11 h 41, sans qu’il ne l’ait déclaré ? Pour la famille de Laurence de Schepper, il ne s’agit pas d’un suicide, mais d’un féminicide. Alors, que s’est-il réellement passé dans les dernières heures de cette mère de famille ?

À la suite, Enquêtes criminelles revient sur une affaire qui a soulevé une vague d'émotion et d'indignation dans tout le pays en février 2025. À Épinay-sur-Orge (Essonne), alors qu’elle rentrait du collège, Louise, 11 ans, est poignardée à mort par un mystérieux individu en doudoune noire. Sur la vidéosurveillance, des voisins reconnaissent Owen L., 23 ans, un jeune homme accro aux jeux vidéo violents et connu de la police. Comment ce drame gratuit et cruel a-t-il bien pu se passer ?

programme.sub-title: Yves Chatain : un tueur en série en liberté ? (1/2)
programme.desc:
C’est l’histoire d’un crime résolu de façon inattendue, presque inespérée, après trente-six ans de mystère. 
Le 8 mai 2022, Yves Chatain, un chauffeur routier de 56 ans, avoue le meurtre de Marie-Thérèse Bonfanti, une jeune mère de famille disparue à Pontcharra (Isère) le 22 mai 1986. Pour les proches de la mère de famille, cette révélation a un goût amer. Car le suspect pourrait bien ne jamais aller en prison ! En effet, pour la justice, le crime serait prescrit. C’est d’autant plus cruel et frustrant que le suspect était dans le dossier depuis le début : la maison devant laquelle Marie-Thérèse s’est volatilisée appartenait en effet à Yves Chatain, et plusieurs témoignages, dont celui du mari de la disparue, attestent de la présence du propriétaire sur les lieux ce jour-là ! Comment est-il possible que l’homme n’ait pas vraiment été inquiété alors qu’à l’époque il avait déjà été condamné pour des faits de violence ?
Et ce n’est pas tout : l’affaire Bonfanti ne serait pas un cas isolé. Yves Chatain est aujourd’hui suspecté dans plusieurs autres affaires criminelles… 

À la suite, Enquêtes criminelles revient sur la disparition en septembre 2018 près de Strasbourg de Sophie Le Tan. L’étudiante de 20 ans avait répondu à une offre sur un site de petites annonces gratuites : un studio pas trop cher à Schiltigheim. Seulement, elle n’est jamais revenue du rendez-vous. Serait-elle tombée dans un piège ? Les policiers remontent le fil de l’enquête jusqu’à Jean-Marc Reiser. Un homme au profil particulièrement inquiétant et qui habite justement dans l’immeuble où Sophie Le Tan devait se rendre….

programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.sub-title: Qui a tué la belle-sœur de l’influenceuse Magali Berdah ? (1/2)
programme.desc:
Un double crime sanglant, un suspect que tout accable et un procès qui n’aura peut-être jamais lieu. Cela paraît inconcevable, et pourtant c’est l’éventualité à laquelle se préparent Melissa, Kim et Julie, les trois filles de Karine Teboul. Cette maman solo de 50 ans et son compagnon, Frédéric Ruberto, 46 ans, ont été sauvagement assassinés dans la nuit du 9 au 10 octobre 2021 au domicile de ce dernier à Allauch, une petite commune des environs de Marseille (Bouches-du-Rhône). 
« Bonne nuit, je t’aime, je t’envoie un message demain matin. » Après ce SMS envoyé à l’une de ses filles, Karine ne donnera plus aucun signe de vie. Inquiète, l’aînée de la fratrie se rend à l’adresse où la mère de famille passe tous ses week-ends. Dès qu’elle franchit le seuil de l’appartement, la jeune femme de 23 ans découvre les corps meurtris du couple, grossièrement dissimulés sous un drap. Sidérée, Julie ressort et crie à l’aide. Deux voisins viennent à son secours. L’un d’eux, Alexis Moumdjian, se montre très prévenant à l’égard de la jeune femme traumatisée. Impossible alors d’imaginer que l’homme en train de la réconforter serait en réalité le meurtrier. 
Seulement, aiguillés par un résident de l’immeuble, les enquêteurs soupçonnent rapidement Alexis Moumdjian. Problème : le suspect va nier les faits envers et contre toutes les preuves accablantes. Mais surtout : il va utiliser sa dépression et invoquer une abolition du discernement pour échapper à un procès. Et jusqu’ici sa stratégie s’est avérée payante : il est sorti de prison et doit se plier à un simple suivi psychiatrique. 
Un scandale pour les trois filles de Karine Teboul ainsi que pour son frère Stéphane et sa belle-sœur, la célèbre influenceuse Magali Berdah. Aujourd’hui, tous prennent la parole pour réclamer justice et dénoncer les dysfonctionnements d’un système qui laisse en liberté un homme dont la dangerosité a été formellement établie. 

Dans la deuxième partie de l’émission, Enquêtes Criminelles s’intéressera au meurtre de Sophie Lionnet. Mercredi 20 septembre 2017, à Londres, un Français est arrêté en train de brûler dans son jardin les restes d’un corps humain. Ouissem Medouni vit avec sa compagne Sabrina et les deux enfants de celle-ci. L’autopsie révèle que le corps calciné est celui de Sophie Lionnet, leur nounou. Morte noyée dans la baignoire de la salle de bain du couple, elle a été brûlée dans le barbecue familial. En France, les parents de Sophie ignorent encore tout du calvaire que leur fille a subi avant de mourir.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Un sergent d'artillerie est retrouvé assassiné dans un parc national après une mission au Liberia où il formait des gardes forestiers à lutter contre le braconnage. Gibbs enquête avec May Dawson, la policière montée qui a découvert le corps, tandis que Vance compose avec les pressions de l'ambassadeur du Liberia.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: À l'approche de leur mariage, Delilah supporte de plus en plus difficilement le stress des préparatifs. En parallèle, le NCIS enquête à bord d'un navire de la Navy après la mort suspecte d'un second maître affecté au service de restauration.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs, McGee et Torres partent dans une région isolée du Paraguay, sous le contrôle d'un groupe de rebelles, pour retrouver un Navy Seal disparu lors d'une mission non autorisée. Une opération à haut risque qui pourrait avoir de lourdes conséquences pour l'équipe.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Le NCIS est une agence fédérale dont la mission est d'enquêter sur les crimes qui touchent de près ou de loin au milieu des Marines.

programme.desc: Le NCIS est une agence fédérale dont la mission est d'enquêter sur les crimes qui touchent de près ou de loin au milieu des Marines.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Le NCIS accueille Jacqueline Sloane, spécialiste en psychologie médico-légale. Alors qu'un ouragan frappe la région, l'équipe enquête sur l'enlèvement d'une enseigne de vaisseau. Torres et Bishop doivent embarquer en pleine mer pour poursuivre leurs investigations.

programme.title: Les apprentis aventuriers
programme.desc: L’issue du dernier duel rapproche les équipes de la finale. Mais les tensions et la fatigue restent bien présentes. Une nouvelle épreuve les attend : mémoriser le contenu de quinze coffres pour récolter de précieuses perles.

programme.desc: Alors qu'ils tentent d'innocenter un ex-Marine dans une affaire de meurtre, les agents rompent le protocole lorsqu'ils apprennent que l'homme est recherché par les services d'immigration.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.sub-title: S14 E8 - Une femme de cran
programme.desc: Leon Vance prend au sérieux des menaces de mort adressées à une députée du Congrès, Jenna Flemming. Alors que les agents étudient une liste de suspects fournie par l'assistant de la députée, celui-ci est retrouvé mort peu de temps après.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Un aumônier de la Navy et ancien imam est retrouvé dans une mise en scène d'accident de voiture. L'enquête du NCIS établit que la victime cherchait à innocenter un homme emprisonné à tort depuis 11 ans à Guantanamo.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: L'empoisonnement d'un capitaine conduit le NCIS sur une affaire liée à la mère de Ducky, décédée depuis longtemps. Cette enquête replonge le médecin légiste trente-sept ans en arrière : à l'approche des fêtes, la fille de Fornell encourage son père à quitter le domicile de Gibbs pour reprendre sa vie en main.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Après plusieurs mois de préparation, le NCIS lance l'opération Willoughby pour arrêter un puissant homme d'affaires soupçonné d'orchestrer des attentats afin d'influencer les marchés financiers. Lorsque Clayton Reeves, infiltré comme pilote, est démasqué, l'équipe comprend qu'une taupe est à l'œuvre. Bishop fait appel aux talents de son petit ami traducteur, Qasim Naasir.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.sub-title: S15 E5 - Une histoire à raconter
programme.desc: Gibbs autorise Clayton Reeves à enquêter sur l'enlèvement d'une amie rencontrée aux Alcooliques Anonymes. L'affaire se complique lorsque le compagnon de la jeune femme, un ingénieur civil, disparaît à son tour après avoir dérobé des informations militaires.

programme.title: Enquête d'action
programme.sub-title: Coups de folie et routes dangereuses : les gendarmes du Médoc en première ligne (1/2)
programme.desc: Un coup de feu retentit dans un village au nord de Bordeaux. Le PSIG est en état d’alerte. Une mère de famille et sa fille sont en danger. L’ex-conjoint, armé, tenterait de s’introduire de force à leur domicile. L’adjudant Alexandre ignore qu’il va vivre l’une des interventions les plus éprouvantes de sa carrière. Disparition en plein cœur de la forêt, découverte d’une carcasse de voiture calcinée, traque des chauffards sur les routes : « Enquête d’action » accompagne les gendarmes du Médoc, un territoire mondialement célèbre pour ses vignobles.\r\nFin de soirée électrique pour l’adjudant Frédéric. Un homme vient d'être renversé de son scooter. Menacé d’un couteau, il a été dépouillé par plusieurs individus. Les soupçons se portent rapidement vers des membres de la communauté des gens du voyage. Plusieurs campements sont installés de longue date aux alentours. Équipés d’un HK G36, fusil d’assaut réservé aux situations les plus extrêmes, les gendarmes commencent les recherches. \r\nLes patrouilles réservent parfois leur lot de surprises. À Lacanau, l’adjudant Alexandre tombe nez à nez avec un fêtard ivre qui a pris la rue pour des sanitaires. Dans cette région où les troisièmes mi-temps de rugby sont une institution, la scène prête à sourire. Mais uriner sur la voie publique en pleine rue peut exposer à bien plus qu'une simple contravention.

Un homme vient d'être renversé de son scooter. Menacé d’un couteau, il a été dépouillé par plusieurs individus. Les soupçons se portent rapidement vers des membres de la communauté des gens du voyage. Plusieurs campements sont installés de longue date aux alentours. Équipés d’un HK G36, fusil d’assaut réservé aux situations les plus extrêmes, les gendarmes commencent les recherches. \r\nLes patrouilles réservent parfois leur lot de surprises. À Lacanau, l’adjudant Alexandre tombe nez à nez avec un fêtard ivre qui a pris la rue pour des sanitaires. Dans cette région où les troisièmes mi-temps de rugby sont une institution, la scène prête à sourire. Mais uriner sur la voie publique en pleine rue peut exposer à bien plus qu'une simple contravention.

programme.title: Non élucidé

programme.title: Alerte enlèvement

programme.sub-title: Khéops et le tombeau des secrets
programme.desc: La pyramide de Khéops a donné lieu à un chantier colossal qui a duré au moins 25 ans. Comment les bâtisseurs de l'époque sont-ils parvenus à réaliser cette prouesse ?

programme.title: Pyramides : les mystères révélés
programme.desc: Au coeur de Saqqarah se trouve la pyramide du pharaon Djézer. En dessous de Djézer, s'étendent des kilomètres de galeries secrètes, un réel exploit technique.

programme.title: Pyramides : les mystères révélés

programme.title: Non élucidé

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Le 9 août 2004, les corps de Robert Drouvin et de sa compagne, Marianne Kubala, sont retrouvés dans le parc de leur propriété à Vernou-sur-Brenne, en Indre-et-Loire. Le corps du vieil homme, 84 ans, est caché sous une bâche en plastique. Celui de sa compagne, 85 ans, est dissimulé derrière un tas de bois.

programme.title: Non élucidé

programme.desc: Brenda et ses hommes sont appelés pour enquêter sur la mort d'un shérif alors qu'ils sont au procès de la famille Baylor contre la police de Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Closer : L.A. enquêtes prioritaires
programme.desc: Brenda et son équipe enquêtent sur le meurtre par balles du principal d'un lycée, qui entretenait des relations difficiles avec les enseignants.

programme.title: The Closer : L.A. enquêtes prioritaires
programme.sub-title: Qui veut la peau du Père Noël ?
programme.desc: Un terrible accident de tyrolienne coûte la vie à un sympathique Père Noël. Les freins ont lâché et la victime a heurté de plein fouet une cheminée.

programme.title: The Closer : L.A. enquêtes prioritaires
programme.desc: Un individu, placé sous la surveillance du FBI, est tué de deux balles dans la tête. De son côté, Brenda apprend une mauvaise nouvelle concernant son père.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Le samedi 6 août 2011, les pompiers d'Annemasse en Haute-Savoie sont prévenus par un appel anonyme de la présence d'un homme blessé gisant sur une route à la sortie de la ville. La victime, âgée de 34 ans, s'appelle Grégory Mercier. Son meurtre d'une violence inouïe semble incompréhensible. Les enquêteurs s'étonnent de ne recueillir aucun témoignage alors que le crime a été commis sur la voie publique. C'est alors qu'une dénonciation va relancer l'enquête.

programme.desc: Sur le site de Dahchour à 40 kilomètres au sud du Caire, deux pyramides rivalisent de beauté. Les archéologues ont reçu l'autorisation de les scanner depuis les airs.

programme.title: Pyramides : les mystères révélés
programme.desc: Juste à côté de la pyramide de Khéops, d'autres chefs-d'oeuvre architecturaux défient la loi du temps, comme les pyramides des pharaons Khéphren et Mikérinos.

programme.title: Pyramides : les mystères révélés
programme.sub-title: Abou Rawash et la pyramide disparue
programme.desc: A Abou Rawash se trouvent les vestiges d'une pyramide, devenue aujourd'hui un monticule de pierre et un puits gigantesque descendant à plus de 21 mètres.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Saint-Malo, 1er septembre 1999. Le docteur Yves Godard et ses deux enfants, Camille et Sirius, embarquent à bord d'un voilier de location pour une croisière de cinq jours. Quelques jours plus tard, des pêcheurs découvrent le bateau vide. Une enquête est ouverte. Des traces de sang sont retrouvées dans la voiture familiale ainsi qu'au domicile des disparus. Marie-France, la mère de famille, s'est également volatilisée.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.sub-title: L'affaire des disparues de la gare
programme.desc: En octobre 2014 un homme est arrêté dans le cadre de l'enquête sur l'affaire des disparues de Perpignan. Déjà condamné dans une affaire d'agression sexuelle, Jacques Rançon a avoué les crimes. Comment a-t-il pu échapper aux enquêteurs pendant tant d'années ? Quel est le parcours criminel de ce tueur en série ? A-t-il commis d'autres meurtres ?

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Avril 2008. Chamalières dans la banlieue de Clermont Ferrand. Olivier Arnaud est assassiné de deux balles. Il allait avoir 30 ans. programme.title: The Closer : L.A. enquêtes prioritaires
programme.desc: Le lieutenant Flynn est témoin d'un accident de voiture impliquant la femme d'un commissaire. Celle-ci, ivre, a pris la fuite après avoir percuté une moto.

programme.title: The Closer : L.A. enquêtes prioritaires
programme.desc: L'action intentée contre Brenda devant la Cour fédérale atteint son point critique lorsqu'un autre meurtre se retrouve lié à la mort de Turell Baylor.

programme.title: The Closer : L.A. enquêtes prioritaires
programme.desc: Brenda emploie des mesures extrêmes pour prouver que l'avocat de la défense, son ennemi de longue date, est complice de son client dans une affaire de viol.

programme.title: The Closer : L.A. enquêtes prioritaires
programme.sub-title: Un chien, deux aigles et trois témoins
programme.desc: Dans une société d'achat et de vente d'or, Flynn et Provenza assistent sans le savoir à un cambriolage : le propriétaire a été assassiné à l'arrière du magasin.

programme.title: Ce soir, je vais tuer l'assassin de mon fils
programme.desc: Après avoir renversé un enfant à vélo, un automobiliste fuit les lieux du drame. Le père du garçon décide de rechercher le meurtrier de son fils.
